name: Helicone
desc: Open-source LLM gateway and observability layer
desc_zh: 开源的 LLM 网关与可观测平台，2026-03 被 Mintlify 收购
solves: The provider dashboard shows totals, so a doubled bill tells you nothing. Point base_url at Helicone and every call, cost and error is attributed to a user.
solves_zh: 服务商后台只有总额，账单翻倍了也查不出原因。把 base_url 指向 Helicone，每次调用、成本和错误都能归到具体用户。
best_for: When you need to attribute spend and failures to specific users or features.
best_for_zh: 当你要把花费和失败归因到具体用户或功能。
